discomName: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Ltd (TNPDCL, formerly TANGEDCO)

connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — derived from TNPDCL's own bill calculator (https://www.tnebnet.org/awp/tariffMaster, tariff code LA1A, bi-monthly), queried on 2026-10-10 at 100, 200, 201, 300, 400, 401, 500, 501, 600, 601, 800, 801, 1000, 1001 and 1200 units; every result is reproduced by this file. Rates here are what the consumer pays after the Government tariff subsidy: Rs 4.70/unit up to 400 units, 6.30 for 401-500, 8.40 for 501-600, 9.45 for 601-800, 10.50 for 801-1000, 11.55 above 1000. The calculator's 'Total Current Charges' line shows the pre-subsidy tariff as 4.95 / 6.65 / 8.80 / 9.95 / 11.05 / 12.15. Free units: 100 for every domestic consumer, plus a further 100 (units 101-200) only when the bi-monthly total is 500 units or less, from 10 May 2026. No fixed charge, fuel surcharge or electricity tax appears on the domestic result. The net amount is rounded to a whole rupee. Not modelled: the 'Monthly' billing-cycle option (for bills covering fewer than 35 days), which uses halved bands.

SOURCED (secondary) — TANGEDCO LT Commercial (General Purpose) category, per tneb.billcalculator.in/tneb-tariff-rates/ and tnebbillcalculator.com/tneb-tariff-details/ (two independent calculator sites, cross-checked, matching figures) citing TNERC's CPI-indexed tariff order. Bimonthly total consumption up to 100 units billed at Rs.6.65/unit, above 100 units at Rs.10.45/unit — this appears to be a NON-TELESCOPIC (whole-bill-at-one-rate) structure rather than incremental slabs, so representing it as telescopic slabs here may understate bills; not independently verified against a primary TNERC order PDF. Fixed charge steps up above 50kW (to Rs.332/kW then Rs.608/kW) — not modelled. 5% State Electricity Tax applies on the energy charge. Pending primary TNERC order cross-check.

SOURCED (secondary) — TANGEDCO LT-IIIB Industries & IT category, per tneb.billcalculator.in/tneb-tariff-rates/ and tnebbillcalculator.com/tneb-tariff-details/ (cross-checked, matching figures): flat rate Rs.8.25/unit + Rs.84/kW fixed charge (0-50kW band; steps up to Rs.165/kW and Rs.608/kW at higher loads, not modelled). Separate lower-rate sub-categories exist for cottage/micro industries (~Rs.4.95-7.15/unit) and power looms — not modelled. 5% State Electricity Tax applies. Pending primary TNERC order cross-check.

SOURCED (secondary) — TANGEDCO LT-IV Agricultural category, per tneb.billcalculator.in/tneb-tariff-rates/ and tnebbillcalculator.com/tneb-tariff-details/: fully subsidised/free supply for agricultural (pump-set) connections, exempt from electricity tax. Pending primary TNERC order cross-check.

subsidySchemes.schemeName: Second 100 free units (bi-monthly use up to 500 units)

verifiedBy: Domestic rates checked against TNPDCL's own bill calculator on 10 October 2026 at 15 consumption levels (100 to 1,200 units); every result matched to the rupee. Commercial, industrial and agriculture rates are from secondary sources and are approximate.
